race.comment: RUNRANIRUN (2) showed pace when resuming from a ten-month spell over this distance in a BM84 at Randwick last start but she ran out of puff in the concluding stages. This is many lengths easier and she will tighten right up with that testing run under her belt. Nicely in after Cahill's claim and this looks an ideal second-up scenario. NINETTE (6) is back after a year on the sidelines. Opened last prep with a placing in a Rosehill midweeker over 1100m. Lightly raced mare who is trialling in a manner that suggests she has come back in good shape. DIRTBALLER (5) puts an unbeaten record on the line first-up from a five-month lay-off. Took care of inferior runners to this last prep but he should come back stronger this prep and deserves his chance at this level. SHE'S ASSORT (3) dug deep to just arrive in time when first-up over 900m at Newcastle recently. Sparingly raced mare who will be tough to stop again over an extra 100m.
